description: Open a privacy-shielded, buyer-directed AI relay thread ('Verified Buyer #XXXX via DealerDirect AI Relay') with a dealership WITHOUT exposing the buyer's personal email or phone number. Operates as 50-state self-serve software where the buyer is sole principal ($0.00 deal/reveal/broker fee, $0.00 dealer fee forever). Sends an ADF/XML + plain-text checklist, a 15-second human Deal-Desk link, and a machine-to-machine JSON endpoint for Dealership AI Agents, and optionally runs a bounded multi-round Agent Auto-Negotiation Playbook.

auto_negotiate.description: If true (or when walk_away_otd_usd is set), activates the buyer's deterministic bounded Agent Auto-Negotiation Playbook to automatically strip hidden add-ons, cite lower competing quotes on the same pass, and counter across up to max_auto_rounds before pausing for buyer approval.

auto_strip_addons.description: Clean-OTD audit rule (default true): automatically reply requesting removal of any hidden dealer add-ons/markups.

buyer_pass_id.description: Optional active DealerDirect Buyer Shield Pass ID (e.g., 'bp_...') to open a 2nd or 3rd concurrent shielded negotiation thread under the same flat pass.

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's 5-digit US registration ZIP code (e.g., '33131') for accurate tax, title, tag, and OTD calculation.

cross_shop_leverage.description: If true (default), automatically cites any lower verified OTD quote from sibling threads on the same Buyer Shield Pass during auto-negotiation.

financing_type.description: Buyer's planned payment or financing method (default: 'undecided').

max_auto_rounds.description: Maximum autonomous counter-offer rounds (1-5, default 3) when auto_negotiate is enabled.

promo_code.description: Optional VIP / friend promo code to activate a complimentary Buyer Shield Pass.

questions.description: Optional custom verification questions for the sales manager (for classics, defaults automatically include cold-start video, undercarriage rust check, numbers-matching stampings, and enclosed shipping quote).

request_cold_start_video.description: Classic/collector option: explicitly request a cold-start & idle walkaround video.

request_enclosed_shipping_quote.description: Classic/collector option: request an insured enclosed-carrier shipping quote to buyer_zip.

request_numbers_matching_check.description: Classic/collector option: request engine block/VIN stamping numbers-matching verification.

request_undercarriage_photos.description: Classic/collector option: request lift/undercarriage frame & floorpan rust verification.

target_otd_usd.description: Optional opening firm Out-The-Door goal offer in whole USD.

trade_in_summary.description: Optional trade-in summary if applicable (e.g., '2019 Honda Accord EX-L, 54k miles, clean title').

vehicle_id.description: Canonical vehicle ID or 17-character VIN to verify and quote.

walk_away_otd_usd.description: Optional buyer-authorized maximum walk-away Out-The-Door ceiling in whole USD for bounded multi-round AI auto-negotiation.
